slides.title: Our mission, our vision - and it's personal
bullets: Mission: Everkind is your trusted guide. Always on, never judging - helping you take your moment through personalized, AI-powered experiences.
Vision: a world where emotional well-being is woven into everyday life, with calm, compassionate technology that meets people where they are.
"I built this to be the support system I couldn't find: one that's here for you when you need it, understands your reality, and doesn't price you out of healing." - Harrison, Founder

slides.title: Mental health is the leading cause of the disability burden worldwide
bullets: Global impact: nearly 1 billion people live with mental disorders - the largest disability market by population.
Care gap: 30–50% of people who need mental-health care do not seek it due to stigma, awareness, and inaccessibility.
Economic cost: mental disorders drive ~$5 trillion/year in global economic losses, mainly from lost productivity.
U.S. & Canada: mental disorders drive ~20% of all non-fatal disability - more than any other condition.
slides.fine: everkind promotes mental wellness through a self-directed process of building resilience, fostering positive emotions, and improving coping skills.

slides.title: Traditional therapy models lack…
bullets: Accessibility: 60% of people with mental health conditions lack adequate support.
Affordability: average cash-pay psychotherapy runs $143/session.
Availability: in the U.S., fewer than 20% of psychiatrists are available to see new patients.
Wait times: median waits are 67 days for in-person psychiatry and 43 days for tele-psychiatry.
Efficacy: digital therapy reduces depression and anxiety symptoms by 30–50%, similar to in-person care.

slides.title: Strong positive trends in mental health
bullets: AI-driven mental health is growing at 24.6% CAGR.
22.2% of U.S. adults ages 18–21 rely on AI for primary mental health support.
The "Always-On" companion market is valued at $34B in 2024.
TAM: global $160B by 2030; North America $61B by 2030.
"As of July 2025, AI companion apps across the Apple App Store and Google Play have been downloaded 220 million times globally." - Tech Crunch

slides.title: Early indicators - since January 2026
bullets: Installs: 161K+ (growth +774% vs. ~150–400% typical early-app benchmark)
Activated users: 52K+ (+537% vs. ~120–300%)
Tokens processed: 15B+ - demonstrating strong adoption and repeat usage.
slides.fine: Benchmarked vs. typical early-stage consumer health apps, per the deck.

slides.title: Our AI products are deeply technical and proudly human
slides.body: In a saturated market with session-based services like Calm and BetterHelp, everkind's Knowledge Graph offers a unique, personalized advantage by continuously building upon itself over time.
bullets: Empowerment through AI - emotional understanding and resilience that supports balanced decisions.
A unified ecosystem - one multi-model platform across AI journaling and meditation.
Continuous integration & development - proprietary architecture enabling rapid, safe feature development.

slides.title: AI journaling
bullets: Makes reflection interactive and insightful - journaling supports emotional regulation by helping people process and organize thoughts.
Captures patterns and emotional states to uncover personal themes, strengths and growth areas.
Long-term memory supports personal evolution.
AI journaling market is expected to grow 20–25% CAGR through 2033.

slides.title: Personalized meditation
bullets: Turns insight to action - meditation strengthens emotional regulation by calming the nervous system.
Hyper-personalized content generation: meditations are AI-generated from interactions with Journal - 100% unique to you. (Patent pending)
Empathetic delivery: personalized to your mood using specific tone and pace of speech.
New meditations are generated upon request in real time.

slides.title: Our tech is thoughtful, proprietary and scalable
bullets: Secure and private: enterprise-grade security architecture; designed for HIPAA and SOC2 compliance auditing.
LLM agnostic: no vendor lock-in, optimized for cost and latency.
Cloud-agnostic infrastructure: deployable on any cloud.
Dynamic knowledge graph: updates with every interaction.
Automated CI/CD pipelines and multi-product AI coherence - the core engine is a platform, not a single app.

slides.title: Dynamic knowledge graph
slides.body: To provide truly personalized coaching, an AI must understand the user's world - the people, goals, challenges, and values that define their life. Our proprietary Relational Knowledge Graph is designed for exactly this purpose. (Patent pending)
bullets: Proprietary graph-based architecture: maps a user's life as an interconnected network of "objects" (e.g., 'Mom', 'New Job', 'Marathon Goal').
Real-time relevance engine: instantly pulls all related objects and their histories from months or even years prior.

slides.title: Heuristic conversational processor
slides.body: The heart of our user experience is the Heuristic Conversational Engine. The IP is not just the LLM itself, but our entire methodology for harnessing and directing it. (Patent pending)
bullets: Proprietary system prompt architecture refined through millions of user interactions.
Real-world refinement at scale: iterated for over two years, processing over 1 billion tokens in 2025 alone.
Infinite context and memory: dynamically fetches all relevant details from the user's entire history.

slides.title: Narrative mapping engine
slides.body: Our Narrative Genome Mapping Engine moves beyond daily interactions to provide powerful, hierarchical insights over extended periods. (Patent pending)
bullets: Temporal pattern extraction: analyzes messages over calendar-based intervals, extracting themes and sentiment markers.
Hierarchical insights: organizes patterns - e.g., a weekly 'Sunday anxiety' pattern feeding a monthly 'procrastination on major goals' pattern.

slides.title: Our business models are simple and scalable - B2C
bullets: AI journaling–first product capturing high-intent, low-competition search.
Freemium → subscription model driven by habit formation, trust, and contextual feature unlocks.
Strategic paywall placements + 7-day free trial to maximize conversion ($4.16/mo billed at $65.99/year, per the in-app offer shown).
Content-led acquisition + lifecycle engagement to maximize retention and LTV while keeping CAC low.

slides.title: …and recurring - B2B
bullets: Bulk access licensing for employers, insurers, and partners offering scalable mental wellness benefits.
Co-branded deployments integrated into existing wellness, HR, or benefits ecosystems.
Predictable recurring revenue through per-seat or per-member pricing with low marginal cost.
Aggregate team-level insights to proactively mitigate burnout.

bullets: Connected Care: combines Everkind's 24/7 mental wellness platform with Connected Care's mental health practitioner booking; a proving ground for serving a consented youth population.
